notes: §1985:VI.5.9.5 GR2: 'The type of editing which may be performed upon an item is dependent upon the category to which the item belongs', with a table giving alphabetic, numeric and alphanumeric items none, alphanumeric edited items 'Simple insertion '0', 'B', and '/'' and numeric edited items 'All, subject to rules in rule 3 below'. AnalyzeCharacterString gives the three plain categories no EditMask, so a store into them edits nothing. Its A/X arm keeps a mask only for the symbols CobolEdit.IsEditedCategorySymbol names, B 0 / without the comma, and FormatSimpleInsertion is the only editing an alphanumeric edited store runs; PictureComposition.Precedence refuses every other editing symbol beside an A or X. A string with any editing symbol and no A or X is NumericEdited, whose store runs CobolEdit.Format with every editing type. The 2023 addition to the alphanumeric edited row, an EDITING character-1, is refused at 85 by VersionConformancePass VisitPictureClause (COBOL0900, probed). Probed at --std 85: PIC XX,XX, X.X, XXZ, A+, X$ and AZ are refused with COBOL1935; PIC B9X0 edits '7Q' to ' 7Q0'; numeric edited pictures run simple, special, fixed and floating insertion and both suppressions. The witness edits PIC XX/XXBXX0 with all three simple insertion characters.

next.reason: 1985 table: alphabetic, numeric, alphanumeric 'None'; alphanumeric edited 'Simple insertion 0, B, and /'; numeric edited 'All'. §2023:13.18.40.5 GR2 (Table 7) keeps None for those three and 'All' for fixed-point numeric-edited, but gives alphanumeric-edited plain 'Simple insertion', whose symbols per §2023:13.18.40.5 GR3 include 'Character-1' of the new EDITING phrase, which §2023:13.18.40.4 GR7 admits in alphanumeric-edited items. ',' is not usable there (Table 10 lets no ',' precede or follow 'A X'). Looser by character-1; floating-point and national rows are new.
